title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
description: Discover free social spaces and activities at Belmont University, from art galleries and carillon concerts to student-only fitness and recreation hubs.

cards.title: Leu Art Gallery
cards.subtitle: Lila D. Bunch Library
cards.notes: Visit this professional gallery space inside the library to view rotating exhibitions by established artists. Admission is free and open to the public during library hours.
cards.short_summary: A free professional art gallery located within the Lila D. Bunch Library.
cards.evidence_claim: While all galleries are free and open to the public, we ask that visitors understand that our gallery hours are subject to change based on the academic calendar and holidays.

cards.title: Bell Tower Carillon Concerts
cards.subtitle: Belmont Bell Tower
cards.notes: Listen to live music played on the 42-bell carillon. Traditional concerts occur throughout the year, including a signature free performance every Christmas Eve at 1:00 p.m.
cards.short_summary: Free live musical performances played on the historic campus carillon.
cards.evidence_claim: The concert features traditional Christmas music played on the tower's 42-bell carillon... Date: Thursday, December 24, 2026. Time: 1:00 p.m. Venue: Bell Tower.
cards.source_title: All Events | The College of Music and Performing Arts at Belmont University
cards.access_notes: Outdoor event; public viewing and listening are free around the Bell Tower area.

cards.title: Beaman Student Life Center
cards.subtitle: Campus Social Hub
cards.notes: Hang out in the central student hub featuring lounges and meeting spaces. It is the primary spot for student organizations and casual social gatherings between classes.
cards.short_summary: The main student center at Belmont offering free lounge and social spaces.
cards.evidence_claim: The Beaman Student Life Center... is ideal for hosting a variety of events: meetings, receptions, dinners, seminars, workshops, screenings and more.
cards.source_title: Beaman Student Life Center - Belmont University
cards.access_notes: Open daily for students; specific hours vary by semester.

cards.title: Belmont Mansion Grounds
cards.subtitle: Historic Estate Gardens
cards.notes: Walk through the meticulously maintained rose gardens and grounds of this historic 1850s estate. While mansion tours require a fee, the exterior grounds are free to explore.
cards.short_summary: The historic gardens and exterior grounds of the Belmont Mansion.
cards.evidence_claim: Then, take an optional self-guided tour of the meticulously maintained rose garden and grounds now part of the Belmont University campus... starting from the front steps.
cards.access_notes: Grounds are accessible during daylight hours; interior tours require a paid ticket.

cards.title: FitRec Group Fitness Classes
cards.subtitle: Beaman Student Life Center
cards.notes: Join free group fitness sessions including Yoga, Pilates, and Barre. These classes are included for all degree-seeking students as part of their standard student fees.
cards.short_summary: Free group exercise classes for Belmont students at the fitness center.
cards.evidence_claim: Degree-seeking students who are enrolled in classes and have paid the applicable student fees... receive access to the fitness center... Available Group Fitness Classes: Barre, Yoga, Pilates.
cards.source_title: Group Fitness & Special Events - Belmont University
cards.access_notes: Requires a valid Belmont Student ID for entry and participation.

cards.title: Fannie Mae Dees Park
cards.subtitle: Dragon Park
cards.notes: Relax at this public park adjacent to campus, famous for its large mosaic dragon sculpture. It is a popular spot for students to picnic or study outdoors for free.
cards.short_summary: A public park near campus known for its iconic mosaic dragon sculpture.
cards.evidence_claim: While parking can be a challenge, the park's free admission and convenient location near Hillsboro Village make it a highly recommended destination.
cards.source_title: Fannie Mae Dees Park Picnic Shelter - Nashville.gov
cards.access_notes: Public park open from dawn until 11:00 p.m. daily.

cards.title: Bruin Athletic Events
cards.subtitle: Curb Event Center
cards.notes: Attend home basketball and volleyball games for free. Students simply scan their Belmont ID at the door to support the Bruins in NCAA Division I action.
cards.short_summary: Free admission for students to all home athletic games at the Curb Event Center.
cards.evidence_claim: Students get in free to all home men's and women's basketball games with their student ID... Students get in to all home volleyball games free.
cards.access_notes: Valid Belmont Student ID required for free entry; doors typically open 60 minutes before tip-off.

cards.title: Gabhart Flex Room
cards.subtitle: Gabhart Student Center
cards.notes: Utilize this versatile multipurpose space for student-led activities and gatherings. It is a dedicated area for student programming and informal group meetups.
cards.short_summary: A flexible student-only space for meetings and social programming.
cards.evidence_claim: Located in the corner of the Gabhart Student Center... this versatile multipurpose space is designed to support a wide range of student programming and events.
cards.access_notes: Accessible to students during building hours; can be reserved for specific organization events.

cards.title: Gallery 121
cards.subtitle: Leu Center for the Visual Arts
cards.notes: Explore student and emerging artist exhibitions in this dedicated gallery. It hosts annual juried student shows and BFA senior exhibitions, all free to the public.
cards.short_summary: A campus gallery showcasing student and emerging artist works.
cards.evidence_claim: Gallery 121 is located inside the Leu Center for the Visual Arts... This space is dedicated to exhibitions that enhance the educational mission... admission is always free.

cards.title: Library Computer & Internet Use
cards.subtitle: Lila D. Bunch Library
cards.notes: Access online resources and general internet for free at library computer stations. This service is available to both students and community guests during designated hours.
cards.short_summary: Free public access to computers and internet at the campus library.
cards.evidence_claim: Guests may use the library's computers to access Belmont's online resources or for general internet use... Guests may access the library building from 9am to 5pm Monday through Saturday.
cards.source_title: Q. Can guests access the library? - Ask Lila!
cards.access_notes: Guest access is limited to 9:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. Monday-Saturday and 1:00 p.m. to 5:00 p.m. Sunday.
